purpose: Freeze the common mathematical contract, benchmark separation, expansion rules, and thermal policy before opening any Evidence-to-Support v2 predictions.

target_use.disclosure: Earlier variants have already exposed benchmark scores. V2 is therefore a theory-registered posthoc method iteration, not a never-seen-target validation claim.

common_energy.unary: y_i is the continuous query evidence and c_i is its separately represented reliability; neither may be replaced by binary reachability
common_energy.pairwise: w_ij is a symmetric query-independent scene relation; g_i is a query-positive relevance gate applied only to pairwise conductance
common_energy.normalization: symmetric degree normalization is recomputed after applying the query gate
common_energy.constraints: registered high-confidence positive and negative observations are eliminated from the linear system as exact 1/0 constraints
common_energy.selection: continuous probability is rendered directly; connected-component selection is disabled by default
common_energy.compatibility: all pre-v2 solver defaults and frozen evaluator behavior remain bit-for-bit unchanged

spin9.diagnosis: cross-view completion after locking reliable full-mask reference observations
spin9.primary_gate: development macro IoU >= 0.90 and no scene regresses by more than 0.01 from v1 query-conditioned diffusion
spin9.expansion: run the other six scenes only if the primary gate passes

nvos.diagnosis: sparse signed unary construction and hard-seeded continuous propagation
nvos.strict_gate: sentinel macro must exceed the v1 strict raw sentinel macro 0.61389329, at least one sentinel improves, and neither regresses by more than 0.03
nvos.expansion: run strict full8 only after the strict gate; report compatible full8 separately and never label it strict unseen-view

lerf3d.diagnosis: semantic target/readout mismatch, not graph connectivity
lerf3d.primary_gate: both development scenes improve average precision and oracle IoU over the compact-field v1 input before any full4 expansion

thermal_policy.rationale: Prefer uninterrupted jobs and sparse health checks; intervene only on sustained high temperature rather than single readings.
